description: This dataset contains lake sediment geochemistry data from Event LTp22-1, collected at coordinates 21.28°N, 104.69°W, with an elevation of 1430 meters. It features depth, age, and various elemental concentrations including Silicon, Potassium, Calcium, and Iron, all presented as Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) transformations. The records span from 1915 to 2018, providing a temporal resolution of years. Additionally, it includes coherent/incoherent scattering ratios. Researchers can use this data to analyze historical environmental changes, trace sediment sources, and study geochemical processes in lake ecosystems over the past century.
